title: Author says there were 'real concerns' about David Walliams within publishing industry
description: The comedian denies allegations of sexual misconduct, inappropriate behaviour and abusing his power more than 10 years ago.

title: 'I felt like I was being manipulated': Woman alleges Walliams groomed her as a teenager
description: Lilly Creightmore, who has alleged Walliams "groomed" her as a teenager, has told BBC Newsnight that she was "angry" at his behaviour.

title: Some under-25s should get less benefits, Milburn review to say
description: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.

title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

title: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
description: Following a wreath-laying ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at by a US Army sentinel to be quiet.

title: Thousands of schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
description: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

title: Scottish DJ, 32, confirmed as victim of Krakow shooting
description: The man, who is understood to be James Thomas Campbell from Prestwick, died when a lone gunman opened fire in central Krakow on Saturday.

title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
description: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

title: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
description: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
